senses.gloss: स- + अलस स- + अलस, adj. languid, Ṛt. 6, 30.
स- + आलम्ब स- + आलम्ब, adj. supported, Kathās. 12, 175.
सलिल- + उच्चय सलिल- + उच्चय, adj. having plenty of water, MBh. 3, 8334.
शल्य- + उद्धार शल्य- + उद्धार, m. 1. extraction of foreign substances from the body. 2. cleansing and purifying a new house.
सलिल- + उपप्लव सलिल- + उपप्लव, m. inundation, Rājat. 5, 70.
शालि- + ओदन शालि- + ओदन, boiled rice, Bhartṛ. 2, 79.
साल- + ग्राम साल- + ग्राम, m. a stone, a species of ammonite worshipped by the Vaiṣṇavas.
शाल्व- + पति शाल्व- + पति, m. the king of the Śālvas, Chr. 18, 34.
शाला- + मृग शाला- + मृग, m. a jackal, Rām. 3, 52, 45.
स- + लज्ज स- + लज्ज, adj., f. जा. 1. ashamed. 2. bashful, Pañc. 45, 8; Daśak. in Chr. 182, 1. 3. modest, Hit. iii. d. 64. [] ˚जम्, acc. sing. n. adv. bashfully, Daśak. in Chr. 187, 19; Vikr. 22, 12.
स-लील स-लील, adj. wanton, sportive. ˚लम्, adv. affectionately, Kir. 5, 33.

सलिल सलिल (vb. सृ, cf. सर), n. Water, Pañc. 165, 7.
 --Comp.
स- + लेश स- + लेश, adj. entire, Kirāt. 14, 2.
शालि- + वाहन शालि- + वाहन, m. the name of a king.
शाला- + वृक शाला- + वृक, m. 1. a jackal, Draup. 6, 8. 2. a monkey. 3. a cat. 4. a dog. 5. a deer.

शल् शल्, i. 1, Ātm.
 1. To shake, to tremble (cf. चल्).
 2. To cover.
 --i. 1, Par. To go, to run. Cf. श्वल् and शठ्.
 --With the prep. उद् उद्, i. 1, Par. To start up, Śiś. 3, 37.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. उच्छलित.
 1. Starting up, bubbling up, Pañc. i. d. 148.
 2. Uncovered, Vikr. 57, 19.
 --With प्रोद् प्र-उद्, To spurt out, Śiś. 2, 66.
† शाल् शाल्, see शाड्.
† सल् सल्, i. 1, Par. To go (cf. सृ).

शल शल, probably शॄ + अ (with ल् for र्),
 I. m. and n. The quill of a porcupine.
 II. m.
 1. A dart.
 2. A kind of field.
 3. Brahman.

शाल शाल (cf. साल),
 I. m.
 1. A tree, Shorea robusta (ŚKD.), MBh. 9, 3239; 14, 2521.
 2. A fish, Ophiocephalus wrahl Ham., Hiḍ. 2, 18.
 3. Śālivāhana.
 II. f. ला.
 1. A large [] branch of a tree.
 2. A hall.
 3. A stable, Hit. i. d. 135, M.M.
 4. A house.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. A.S. heal, A hall.

साल साल (cf. शाल),
 I. m.
 1. A wall surrounding a building, a wall in general, Daśak. in Chr. 201, 1.
 2. A tree, Shorea robusta, Man. 8, 246.
 3. A tree in general.
 4. A fish, Ophiocephalus Wrahl.
 II. f. ला, A house.
शलक शलक, m. A spider; Pañc. iii. d. 179, read शलाकां.

शलाका शलाका (cf. शल), f.
 1. A javelin.
 2. An arrow.
 3. A small stake, rod, the bar of a cage, Pañc. iii. d. 179; a rib of an umbrella, etc.
 4. A fibrous stick used as a brush or pencil, Suśr. 1, 33, 18; a pencil, Ragh. 7, 8.
 5. A porcupine.
 6. A piece of ivory used in particular games, a domino, MBh. 5, 1225 (read ˚का-धूर्तान्, Sharpers).
 7. A bone.
 8. A bird, Turdus gosalica.
 --Comp.

शल्लक शल्लक (cf. शल्क and शल्य),
 I. m. A plant, Bignonia indica.
 II. f. की,
 1. A porcupine.
 2. The gum olibanum tree, Boswellia thurifera, Vikr. d. 107.
 III. n. Bark, rind.

शलभ शलभ (cf. शरभ), m.
 1. A grasshopper, Pañc. i. d. 369; iv. d. [] 58 (cf. पतङ्ग).
 2. A locust, Arj. 7, 24; Chr. 34, 13.
शलल शलल (cf. शल), n., and f. ली, The quill of a porcupine, Pāraskara Gṛ. S. ii. 1, in Journ. of the German Oriental Society, vii. 532 (ली).
शलाटु शलाटु, adj. Unripe.

शल्क शल्क, probably शॄ + क (with ल् for र्), n.
 1. A part.
 2. The bark of a tree.
 3. The scale of a fish.
 --Comp.
† शल्भ् शल्भ्, i. 1, Ātm. To boast.

शल्य शल्य, i. e. शल + य,
 I. m. and n.
 1. A dart, a javelin.
 2. An arrow, Utt. Rāmac. 46, 14; Chr. 30, 1 (m.).
 II. m.
 1. A peg, a pin.
 2. A porcupine.
 3. A thorny shrub, Vangueria spinosa.
 4. A boundary.
 5. The name of a king, Johns. Sel. 50, 98.
 III. n.
 1. Any stake or thorn, Bhartṛ. 2, 97.
 2. An iron crow.
 3. Any extraneous substance which has lodged in the body, as an arrow or thorn.
 4. [] Difficulty.
 5. Poison.
 6. Sin.
 7. Abuse.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. κῆλα, pl.

शल्यक शल्य + क, m.
 1. A thron, a stake.
 2. A dart, a pike.
 3. A hedgehog, Man. 12, 65.
 4. A porcupine, ib. 5, 18; Bhāg. P. 3, 10, 22.

शल्यवन्त् शल्य + वन्त्, adj.
 1. Shooting arrows, one who has shot an arrow, Man. 9, 44.
 2. Set with stakes.
 3. Harassed with difficulties.
शल्व शल्व, m. The name of a country.

शाल्व शाल्व, i. e. शल्व + अ, m.
 1. pl. The inhabitants of Śalva, Sāv. 2, 7; Chr. 5, 6; 18, 34; 35.
 2. The king of the Śālvas, ib. 14, 26.

साल्व साल्व, m.
 1. = शाल्व.
 2. The name of a demon.

शालभञ्जी शालभञ्जी, and शालभञ्जिका शालभञ्जिका, i. e. शाल-भञ्ज् + अ + ई, and + क, f.
 1. A doll.
 2. A kind of play in the east of India.
शालाजिर शालाजिर, m. and n. A hollow earthen cup.

शालार शालार, n.
 1. A ladder.
 2. The claw of an elephant.
 3. A bird-cage.

शालि शालि, m.
 1. Rice, Pañc. 163, 23.
 2. The civet or polecat.

शालिक शालिक, i. e. शाला̆ + इक,
 I. adj. Relating or belonging to the Shorea robusta, a hall, etc.
 II. m.
 1. A weaver.
 2. A village of artificers.
 3. A tax.

शालिता शालिता, i. e. शालिन् + ता, f.
 1. Possessing.
 2. Confidence in.

शालिन् शालिन्, i. e. शाला + इन्,
 I. adj., f. नी.
 1. Belonging to a house, domestic.
 2. Endowed with, Kathās. 46, 107; Kir. 5, 32; possessed of, having, Pañc. v. d. 12.
 3. Shining or resplendent with.
 II. f. नी, A proper name, Lass. 39, 8.
 --Comp.

शालिहोत्र शालिहोत्र, m.
 1. The name of a writer on veterinary medicine, Nal. 19, 28; Pañc. 253, 22; 255, 4.
 2. A horse.
शालि- + होत्र शालि- + होत्र, see s. v.
शालिहोत्रज्ञ शालिहोत्र-ज्ञ, adj. Knowing (the precepts of) Śālihotra, Pañc. 255, 1.

शालीन शालीन, i. e. शाला + ईन,
 I. adj.
 1. Ashamed, bashful, humble, Nalod. 2, 3; Ragh. 6, 81; Mālav. 51, 7 (cf. शाल्त्नीकरण, Humbling, Pāṇ. 1, 3, 70).
 2. Like.
 II. m. An opulent householder.

शालु शालु,
 I. m.
 1. A frog.
 2. An astringent substance.
 3. A sort of perfume.
 II. n. The root of the water lily.

शालूक शालूक (cf. the last), n. The root of the esculent water lily.
 --Comp.
शालूर शालूर (cf. शालु), m. A frog.
शालेय शालेय, i. e. शालि + एय, adj. Fit for rice.

शाल्मलि and ली शाल्मली̆, f.
 1. The silk cotton tree, Bombax heptaphyllum, Man. 8, 246.
 2. One of the [] seven द्वीपस्.
 3. ली, A hell, Man. 4, 90.
 --Comp.
शाल्वेय शाल्वेय, i. e. शल्व + एय, m. pl. The inhabitants of Śalva, Draup. 1, 6.
सलिलपूरवत् सलिल-पूर + वत्, adv. Like a large quantity of water, Pañc. ii. d. 42.
सलिलस्थलचर सलिल-स्थल-चर, adj. sbst. Living in water and on the land, Pañc. 131, 12.
सलिलेशय सलिलेशय, i. e. सलिल + इ + शी + अ, adj. Lying in water, Lass. 50, 7.
सलोकता स-लोक + ता, f. Condition of dwelling in the same world as, Man. 11, 220.
सालभञ्जिका साल-भञ्ज् + इका, f. A doll, a puppet.
सालोक्य सालोक्य, i. e. स-लोक + य, n. Habitation with, Man. 4, 231; MBh. 3, 11184.
साल्वहन् साल्व-हन्, m. Viṣṇu (the slayer of Sālva).
शल्य- + हर्तृ शल्य- + हर्तृ, m. a weeder, Rām. 5, 28, 6.
